lessons.title: Friends forever
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, we've been friends for six years. I'll miss you in junior high.
Ben: Don't worry — true friendship lasts forever.
Anna: We can still share stories on the phone.
Ben: We help each other and forgive each other.
Anna: Yes, trust and kindness keep our friendship strong.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，我们做了六年朋友，上初中我会想你。
本：别担心，真正的友谊永远长存。
安娜：我们可以电话分享故事。
本：我们互相帮助，互相原谅。
安娜：对，信任和善良让友谊牢固。

lessons.title: What makes a true friend
lessons.en: What makes a true friend? First, trust — we tell our secrets to a friend we trust. Second, kindness — a friend smiles and listens. Third, help — a friend stands beside us when we are sad. Finally, forgiveness — friends sometimes make mistakes, but they say sorry and move on. True friendship lasts through the years, and even far apart, two hearts stay close.
lessons.cn: 什么是真朋友？第一是信任——把秘密告诉信任的朋友。第二是善良——朋友会微笑会倾听。第三是帮助——伤心时朋友陪在身边。最后是原谅——朋友会犯错，但能道歉、向前看。真正的友谊跨越岁月，即使相隔遥远，两颗心也紧紧相连。
